title: Metadata and favicons: Use Next.js Metadata API and static icon files rather than adding arbitrary head elements at runtime
description: Next.js 16 and TypeScript 5 App Router lesson for metadata and favicons. Includes an intentionally broken starter, a corrected contract, verified-path offline tests and official documentation.
objectives: Use Next.js Metadata API and static icon files rather than adding arbitrary head elements at runtime.
Repair the intentionally failing next-metadata-favicons model.
Explain which behaviors need real Next.js compilation or browser integration verification.
rubric: I can explain metadata and favicons in Next.js 16 without mixing older Pages Router semantics.
I can reproduce and fix the 07.01.07 failing starter with real data inputs.
I can identify the missing Next.js build, routing and HTTP integration evidence.
